contexts.text: The city built by Cain () = everything doctrinal and heretical thence. Wherever the name of any city occurs in the Word, it never signifies a city, but something doctrinal, or heretical; for the Angels are completely ignorant what a city is, or the name of any city; they never have any idea of a city, nor can have... but only perceive what they signify. Illustrated. AC 1187. AC 1191.
City belongs to the class of spiritual expressions.
Cities in the Spiritual World. AC 941. AC 942.
This city is that great one () = doctrinal things, that they prevailed... The reason it is called a great city, is that all falsity of doctrine and of worship thence is derived into falsity of life.
Cities = truths.
Let us build us a city and a tower () = that they invented a doctrine and a worship.
A city = doctrine, or what is doctrinal, both genuine and heretical.
They ceased to build the city () = that such doctrine was not received. City = doctrine.
At that time cities were families which dwelt together.

Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain () = that the external man was in scientifics. A city, or cities = doctrinal things, which in themselves are nothing but scientifics, when predicated of the external man separated from the internal. Cities = doctrinal things, both true and false.
The cities in Heaven described.
The city of praise and of joy () = the things which are of the Church.
Peradventure there be fifty righteous in the midst of the city () = that truths maybe full of goods... City = truth. AC 2261. AC 2268.

The human mind as to truths is compared in the Word to a city, and is also called a city; and as to the goods which are in the truths, it is compared to the inhabitants therein... Truths in the memory without goods, are like a city without inhabitants. AC 2712.
I saw little boys fighting in the streets of a great city... HH 344.
The men of the city () = those who are in falsities... City = truths, also falsities or things contrary to truths.
Everyone who is in the city () = whatever derives anything from truth... City = what is doctrinal, thus truth in its complex.
Lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city () = lest they perish in evils of falsity. City = what is doctrinal, false as well as true.
They set him without the city () = away from falsity.
Look not behind thee () = that he should not look to doctrinal things; for the city was behind him, and the mountain before him. A city = what is doctrinal. AC 2418.
The doctrinal things of charity are called the cities of the mountain, and the doctrinal things of faith, the cities of the plain ().
This city is near to flee to () = that it was allowable from the truth of faith. City = what is doctrinal, thus the truth of faith. AC 2429. AC 2430. AC 2435.

He overthrew those cities () = all truths separated from them, so that they had only falsities. Cities = doctrinal things, thus truths, which are said to be overthrown, when there are falsities instead of truths...
When God destroyed the cities of the plain () = when they perished through falsities of evil.
They suffer themselves to imbue falsities, wherefore it is said, the cities of Moab shall be for a desolation, and they shall leave the cities, and dwell in the rocks ().
By the interior sight he was led by me through the cities where I had been... SE 1933.
City against city (). City = what is doctrinal; here, what is heretical.
Because the doctrine is thus made fit for human apprehension, the well Beersheba... is called a city. A city = what is doctrinal in its complex.
A city = doctrinal truth.
The rational mind, from the goods and truths therein, is in the Word compared to a city, and is called a city...
A city = the rational mind, or, what is the same, the goods and truths therein. References.
The city of emptiness shall be broken () = the human mind deprived of truth.
To all that went in at the gate of his city () = as to the doctrinal things through which is faith... City = the truth which is of faith.

In the Ancient Church, cities were not such cities as there were afterwards, that is, companies and congregations, but were cohabitations of separate families; the family of one parent constituted a city. Example(s). AC 4478.

As nations and families represented the heavenly Societies, thus those things which are of love and charity, when a city is mentioned instead of the family, there is signified the truth which is of faith. Hence the city of God, and the holy city, in the genuine sense, = faith in the Lord; and as a city, or a city = faith, the gate of a city = doctrinal things, because these introduce to faith.
To the city of Nahor () = cognate doctrinal things. A city = what is doctrinal.
Outside the city () = removal from doctrinal things.
The men of the city () = truths.

The inhabitants of a city are in the Word sometimes called the men of the city, sometimes the inhabitants of the city; when they are called the men of the city, truths are signified; when the inhabitants, goods are signified.
Rebekah came out () = the affection of truth from doctrinal things... For she came out of the city, and by a city are signified doctrinal things.

When the Angels are conversing about the doctrinal things of charity and of faith, there sometimes appears in the lower sphere, where there is a corresponding Society of Spirits, the idea of a city, or of cities, with palaces therein... Hence it is evident what is signified by the cities seen by the prophets...
A city = what is doctrinal.
The name of the city Beersheba () = the quality of the doctrine thence... City = doctrine.
Of those who are in ignorance of both good and truth, it is said that they found no city of habitation ().
City = what is doctrinal of truth.
The cities of the Samaritans () = those who are in falsities.
He encamped at the face of the city () = application to the goods of that truth. City = truth.
The men of the city () = those who are in truths of doctrine.
They came upon the city confidently, and killed every male () = that they extirpated the truths of doctrine of the Church with the ancients. City = the doctrine which is of the Church. AC 4503.
They took whatever was in the city, and whatever was in the field () = all the truth and good of the Church. City = what is doctrinal, thus the truth of the Church.

The terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them () = that falsities and evils could not approach... The cities round about them = falsities and evils; for in the genuine sense, cities = truths of doctrine; and in the opposite, falsities of doctrine. The reason evils are also signified here by city is that the inhabitants also are understood.
To burn the city () = to destroy and vastate those who are in doctrinal things of falsity.
The breaches of the city of David () = falsities of doctrine.
To build the waste cities () = to rectify the falsified doctrinal things of truth.
The city through which they are said to run to and fro () = doctrinal things of truth.

Food in the cities () = such things in the interiors of the natural mind... Cities = the interiors of the natural mind. In the universal sense, cities = the doctrinal things of the Church (References); but in the singular sense, they = the interiors of man, where doctrinal things are, or rather where truths are conjoined with good. The truths and goods with man form as it were a city. Explained, Illustrated.
He laid up the food in the cities () = in the interiors, namely, truths adjoined to good. Cities = the interiors of the natural mind.
They laded every man upon his donkey, and returned to the city () = that from sensuous things truths were brought back into scientifics... City = doctrinal truth.
The city, and them that dwell therein () = the truth of the city, and thence good. AC 6297.
He removed that people to cities () = that scientific truths were referred to doctrinal things... Cities = doctrinal things.
When I thought of any city... the Spirits knew in a moment all things I had seen there...
Hence in the Word the things of the Church are compared to a city... and by the assaults upon that city are described attacks upon truth by falsities; wherefore also a city = doctrinal things.
He built cities of storehouses for Pharaoh () = doctrines from falsified truths in the natural where were alienated scientifics. Cities = doctrines in both senses.
To destroy the city () = to destroy the doctrine of the Church.
The city of bloods () = the doctrine of falsity.
Cities = falsities by which they defend evils.
The city of bloods = the falsification of truth.
The cities of the land which are to be cut off () = the truths of the Church.
When evil is compared to a city, falsities are compared to the fortifications around the city.

As I go out of the city () = separation... The city where Pharaoh was = the falsity in which are they who infest; for a city = what is doctrinal, and as it = what is doctrinal, it also = truth, and in the opposite sense, falsity. References.
Heaven is signified by the holy city.
Their habitation is a kind of city...
City = the doctrine of truth. References. AC 9594:end. AC 9643:4.
City = doctrine itself.
There are no cities in Saturn.
The cities over which they who had gained pounds should have Power = truths of faith, and thence intelligence and wisdom.
The cities of the land () = the false doctrinal things of their Church.
The cities which were to be accursed () = false doctrines. AC 9193:3.
The city nearest the slain man () = the truth of doctrine of the Church whose good is extinguished.
The city of God () = the doctrine of truth of faith from the Word.
Cities () = doctrinal things. AC 9755:7.
The city which was to be built upon its own heap () = the doctrine of truth.
The city of bloods () = the Jewish nation relatively to the truth of doctrine with itself; thus abstractedly, the doctrine which destroys good.
The city of spice dealers () = where the doctrine of interior truth is.
When I showed him the city in which I dwelt, he fled away... SE 5513, Explained.
Cities and cities = the doctrines which are of the Church and of religion. References.
(A great city of the Papists in the south, and another in the north, at the time of the Last Judgment.)
(The Judgment upon those who dwelt in these great cities, described.) AE 880.
There are two great cities like London, into which very many of the English come after death. Described. LJCont 43.
The cities in which the Dutch dwell are guarded in a singular way. Described.
Wives who aspire at command over their husbands dwell at one side of the city...

In the northern quarter there are two great cities, into which the Jews are brought after death, and which before the Judgment they called Jerusalems, but by another name after it... The streets of these cities are full of filth ankle-deep... SE 748. SE 750. SE 751.
The name of the city of my God, New Jerusalem () = that the doctrine of the New Church shall be written on hearts.

The reason a city = doctrine, is that land, specifically, the Land of Canaan = the Church in the whole complex; and hence by the inheritances into which the Land of Canaan was divided, are signified various things of the Church, and by the cities in them, doctrinal things; it is from this fact that by cities, when mentioned in the Word, nothing else is understood by the Angels.
That cities = doctrinal things. Illustrated.

Have thou authority over ten cities (). By cities here also, are signified doctrinal things, or truths of doctrine; and by being over them is signified to be intelligent and wise; thus to give authority over them = to give intelligence and wisdom. AE 112:end. AE 223:23. AE 548:4. AE 675:7.

The street of the great city () = the falsity of the doctrine of justification by faith alone... City = doctrine. It is called the great city, because it is the reigning doctrine with the clergy in the whole of the Reformed Christian world...
The tenth part of the city fell () = their separation from Heaven and descent into Hell.

The cities in the Spiritual World which are in evils and falsities, after those who dwell in them have been visited... are shaken by an earthquake, which opens a gulf into which they descend... It so happened with this city.

They said... this was a sign that one of the Jerusalemite cities, where charity was the primary, was near; and they said, Let us go and take the city... But there was a wall round it, and guardian Angels on the wall. Then they said, Let us take it by stratagem...
Then they said... Let us lay siege to this city... This is what is meant by these words in the Revelation... They compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city ().

The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell () = that that Church as to its doctrine is utterly destroyed thereby, and in like manner all the heresies which have emanated from it... A city = the doctrine of the Church, or, what is the same thing, the Church as to doctrine. References. Therefore the cities of the nations = City the heretical doctrines, or heresies, which have emanated from it, and which are many... The great city means the great city spoken of in , which is there called Sodom and Egypt.

The reason a city = doctrine, and thence cities, doctrinal things, is that by land, specifically, by the Land of Canaan is signified the Church; and as the Church is the Church from doctrine and according to it, by cities are signified doctrinal things; these were also taught in cities, because there were the synagogues, and in Jerusalem was the temple. See AE 1019. AE 1020.

The woman whom thou sawest is that great city, which has a kingdom over the Kings of the earth () = that the Roman Catholic religion as to doctrine will reign in the Christian world, and partly also with the Reformed. See AE 1088.

Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city, for in one hour is thy judgment come () = their grievous lamentation that this religiosity, so strongly fortified, could be so suddenly and so utterly overthrown... That great city Babylon = that religiosity... That mighty city = that religiosity so well fortified. AR 788. AE 1134.
That great city () = the Roman Catholic religiosity...
What city is like unto this great city () = that they believed their religiosity to be pre-eminent to every religion in the world. AE 1174. AE 1176.

They compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city () = that they endeavoured to destroy all things of the New Church, and its very doctrine concerning the Lord, and concerning life... The beloved city = the doctrine of the New Church. AR 862.

I, John, saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven () = a New Church to be established by the Lord at the end of the former, which will be consociated with the new Heaven in Divine truths both as to doctrine and as to life... It is called a city, and is described as a city, from doctrine and from life according to it.
He showed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God () = that before him was made manifest the Lord's New Church as to doctrine in the form of a city.

The reason it was seen in the form of a city, is that a city = doctrine, and the Church is the Church from doctrine and from life according thereto. It was also seen as a city in order that it might be described as to all its quality...
The wall of the city () = the Word in the sense of the letter.
The city, which was the holy Jerusalem, = the Church as to doctrine.
The city lieth four-square () = righteousness in it.
The city, or Jerusalem, () = the Lord's New Church as to everything belonging to it interiorly considered, or within the wall.
The street of the city () = the truth of the doctrine of the Church.
The city had no need of the sun () = that the men of that Church will not be in self-love.
To enter through the gates into the city () = to be in the Lord's New Church through Knowledges concerning Him... By the city, or Jerusalem, is signified the New Church with its doctrine.
To take away their part out of the holy city () = out of the New Church, which is the holy Jerusalem.
He introduced them into a little city, in the midst of which was a temple, and all the houses of which were called sacred edifices... They said that this city was the court of Heaven.
The whole city (in Heaven) is then silent.
At last we saw a city (in the Heaven of the silver age)... its houses were all palaces...

A valley (in the Heaven of the iron age) in which there were cities and cities... We entered one great one; its streets were irregular; so were the houses; the latter were built of brick, with beams between, and plastered over...

There were here and there cottages, which at last appeared to meet, and to be joined together in the form of a city; we entered this city (of the Spirits of the age of iron mixed with clay), and lo, the houses were built of scorched branches of trees, cemented together with mud, and roofed with black slates; the streets were irregular; all of them at the entrance were narrows but they widened out as we advanced, and at the end were spacious, where were the places of public resort...
(On a city with very lofty buildings; a city of phantasy.) SE 847. SE 853.
A splendid city, as white as snow, described, where those live who are in the persuasion that faith saves; but live mercifully from conscience.
On a great city.
On a city where was faith alone.
The city was preserved by the presence of some good Spirits in it.
A great city seen in Hell.
The cities in which the evil Spirits dwelt before the Last Judgment, and their subsidence. SE 4927. SE 4930. SE 4944. SE 5034.
The arrangement of the good and evil in the cities there. SE 4987.
On the Dutch cities. LJPost 19.
On the cities in the other life, and on the Lord's Providence in preserving them.

Cities appear to Spirits like the cities on earth; hence there are London, Amsterdam, Stockholm, and all others; the reason is, that every man has Spirits with him, who possess all the things of his memory; they do not indeed see the world through his eyes, but still they are inwardly in it from his ideas; hence ideas of similar houses, edifices, streets, and cities appear to them; and so appear as to be as it were them... Hence it is that the Spirits who are with the men of one city, have an idea of the same city.
There was a conspiracy in a city in which I was. (How it was suppressed.)
Cities there one below another. LJPost 19.
On a great city (of Babylon) there, between the north and the west. SE 5305.
A plan of this city given.
On another great city (Babylon) between the west and the south.
(How it is that in a city there are many who are invisible to the rest.)
On the cities in the other life (Stockholm, London). LJPost 12. Described.
Cities = the doctrinal things of the Church. References.
Famine within the city () = the lack of all truth in doctrine.
A fortified city () = the doctrine of truth.
The city () = the doctrine of truth.
That cities, or cities = doctrines. Illustrated.
I have given thee for a fortified city () = the doctrine of truth protecting from falsities.
The cities of the south are shut up () = that all the truths of doctrine are, which otherwise would be in light.

The vastation of the Church as to doctrine is meant by Thou hast made of the city a heap, of the fortified city a ruin, a palace of strangers of the city; and the establishment of a New Church as to doctrine, is meant by the strong people shall honour Thee, and the city of the mighty nations shall fear Thee ().
A strong city () = the doctrine of genuine truth, which falsities cannot destroy.
Lucifer... made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof () = that he destroyed the Church and its doctrinal things.
The doctrine of falsities of Babylon is what is meant by the city being broken into three parts; and the doctrine of evils thence, by the cities of the nations which fell ().
Not to find a city of habitation () = no doctrine of truth according to which they could live.
Cities () = truths of doctrine.
The city () = the truth of doctrine.
To devastate the cities () = to devastate doctrines.
Cities () = truths of doctrine.
The city, which here is Jerusalem, () = the Church as to doctrine.
Jerusalem = the celestial Church as to the doctrine of truth; hence it is that it is called the city of truth ().

As Zion = the celestial Church, and Jerusalem, the Church as to the doctrine of truth, Zion is called the city of Jehovah; and Jerusalem, the holy city, the city of God, and the city of the great King. Illustrated.
Doctrine which is from the Lord is meant by, saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built ().
The cities of Judah, and the streets of Jerusalem () = the truths of doctrine.
City against city, and kingdom against kingdom () = that doctrine will fight against doctrine, and Church against Church.
Five cities in the Land of Egypt speaking with the lip of Canaan () = the truths of doctrine in abundance which are the genuine truths of the Church.
To loathe the cities () = to loathe the truths of doctrine.
The cities which shall be inhabited () = doctrines derived from goods.

The cities of Judah, and the cities of the mount () = the truths of doctrine which are with those who are of the Lord's Celestial Kingdom; the cities of the plain, and the cities of the south = the truths of doctrine which are with those who are in the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
A city set on a mountain () = the truth of doctrine from the good of love. AE 405:32.

Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city and house divided against itself shall not stand (); kingdom = the Church; city, and house, its truth and good of doctrine, which do not stand, but fall to pieces, if they do not unanimously agree.
A city of the Samaritans into which they were not to enter () = the false doctrine of those who reject the Lord.

When they persecute you in one city, flee ye into another (); city, here also, means the doctrine of falsity from evil; that where it is, the doctrine of truth is not admitted, is meant by, if they were persecuted in one city, they should flee into another.
To go into the streets and lanes of the city () = that they should inquire where they are who receive the truths of doctrine.
The city of bloods () = the doctrine of falsity which does violence to the good of charity. AE 403:23.
Until the cities be laid waste () = the truths of doctrine.
The multitude of the city which shall be left () = where there are truths; for city = the doctrine of truth.
The cities which he laid waste () = doctrine with its truths. AE 14.
Cities () = the doctrinal things of falsity.
The truth of this good is what is meant by the city of the mighty nations (); for a city = the doctrine of truth, or the truths of doctrine.
The cities of Judah which He will build (), means the celestial Church and its doctrine.

That thence everything of the Church, and everything of its doctrine will perish, is signified by the whole land shall be a waste, and the whole city shall flee for the voice of the horsemen and the bowmen (). AE 357:20. AE 411:19.
That the doctrine of falsity will be destroyed, is signified by, the city of emptiness is broken ().
That they may erect a city of habitation () = to make for themselves the doctrine of life; a city = doctrine; and habitation, life.

Such a city dwelleth securely, saying in her heart, I and none beside me () = that such intelligence trusts in itself, and undertakes from proprium; the city = doctrine from such intelligence. AE 650:57.

Five cities in the land of Egypt speaking with the lips of Canaan = many truths of doctrine which are genuine truths of the Church... Cities = truths of doctrine... Each shall be called Ir Heres = doctrine sparkling from spiritual truths in the Natural, for Ir means city, and city = doctrine... AE 654:7.
As a city which coheres together with itself () = the doctrine in which all things are in order.
The multitude of the city () = all the truths of doctrine.
Fortified cities () = false doctrinal things which they have confirmed.

Jerusalem, here, = the Church as to doctrine, which is said to be built as a city which coheres together with itself when all things of its doctrine are in agreement and are unanimous, and when they mutually regard the Lord and love to Him from Him as the beginning and the end. It is said built as a city, because a city = doctrine.
The cities of Judah () = the truths of good.
The city of God () = the Church as to doctrine.

As then they who, from spiritual affection, long for truth, will not find any truth in doctrines, wherever they seek for it, it is said, two or three cities wandered unto one city to drink water, but they were not satisfied; two or three cities = those who are in the affection of truth from good; a city = the truth of doctrine.
The cities of Judah () = the goods and truths of doctrine; the restoration of the Church and of doctrine is signified by their being inhabited and built.
Emptiness of teeth in the cities () = poverty of truth in doctrines.
The desolate cities which the nations shall cause to be inhabited () = truths from the goods of life; desolate cities = the truths of doctrine where before there were no truths.
His cities are burned so that there is no inhabitant () = the destruction of the doctrinal things of the Church by evils, until there is no good of the Church remaining.
The cities of Judah, to which it is said, Behold your God! the Lord Jehovih will come in strength () = doctrinal things from the Word; cities, doctrinal things; and Judah, the Word.
The cities great and good which shall be given them () = doctrinal things from genuine goods and truths.
Cities great and good = doctrinal things which teach the goods of love and of charity.
The violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein () = force brought to bear by falsities upon the truths and goods of the Church, and on its doctrine from the Word.
Their bodies shall lie upon the street of the great city () = the extinction by evils and falsities of doctrine... A city = doctrine.
In the Spiritual World there are cities, and streets in them, as in cities in this world, and the quality of everyone is known... from the part in which he dwells...
The city of emptiness () = the doctrine in which there is no truth, but falsity.
The city of glory () = the doctrine of Divine truth; the city of joy, the delight from the affection of good and truth there.
City () = the doctrine of truth.
The cities which will be devastated, so that there is no man, or inhabitant () = doctrinal things.
According to the number of thy cities were thy gods, Judah () = as many falsities as doctrinal things.
To persecute them from city to city = that from one false doctrine they will wander into another.
The holy city was Zion and Jerusalem; but by these was meant Heaven...

The tenth part of the city fell = that no truths of doctrine existed any longer with those who remained... City = doctrine, and also the truth of doctrine; for doctrine, in order to be the doctrine of the Church, consists of truths from the Word.
A city = doctrine. AE 684:39. AE 750:12.
A city = the doctrine of truth; and the city of holiness (), the Divine Truth which is the Word.
Cities = truths of doctrine.
He shall build my city () = that He will restore the doctrine of truth.
The cities of Judah = doctrinal things, which are truths from the Word.
The city shall be built upon its own heap () = the doctrine from truths which had collapsed through falsities.

The city of habitation which they did not find = the doctrine of life, which makes the Church with man; and as the Church is formed with man through life according to doctrine, when temptations have been passed through, it is said that Jehovah will lead them in the way of right, that they may go to a city of habitation ().
The city of glory, and the city of joy of Jehovah = the doctrine of truth from the Word.
Outside the city () = from Hell; for a city = the doctrine of truth from the Word; but outside the city = the doctrine of falsity from the Word falsified...
Metropolitan cities have a similar signification to that of the kingdoms in which they are... By the kingdom is signified the Church, and by the metropolitan city, the Church as to doctrine.
